verdict.rationale: Docusaurus ships an official CLI whose production build (`npm run build`) emits static files into a `build` directory, and the output can be deployed to static hosts. That makes non-interactive, headless runs possible, and a community report confirms builds running in GitHub Actions. The same report says builds on large sites took over 30 minutes and timed out the runner, and the pack has no first-party CI or automation guidance. missing for 10: first-party CI or headless automation documentation, documented non-interactive flags and exit-code behavior, evidence of reliable CI performance at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: To build the static files of your website for production, run: npm run build
Once it finishes, the static files will be generated within the `build` directory.
its performance on a large documentation site was terrible, even causing the GitHub Actions Runner to time out
